HistoryRecord.title: HistoryRecord
HistoryRecord.description: An archived tweet record containing author, content, media, links, and engagement metrics.

id.description: Unique identifier for the record or tweet status ID

tweetUrl.description: Direct canonical link to the tweet on x.com

authorName.description: Display name of the tweet author

authorAvatarUrl.description: URL of the author profile picture

isVerified.description: Whether the author has a verification badge

text.description: Full text body of the tweet

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the tweet was posted

scannedAt.description: Timestamp when the extension scanned the record

sourcePage.description: URL of the page where the tweet was captured (e.g. x.com/i/history)

/history_records/{recordId}.description: Collection storing archived posts, reading history, and external reference links pushed from the SoroTracker browser extension.
